jobs.command:
set -e
ulimit -c 0
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests > /tmp/pv-optimizer-full-rtx.log 2>&1
TORCH_VULKAN_FORBID_CPU_FALLBACK=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_optimizer_pointwise.py tests/test_complete_training_primitives.py > /tmp/pv-optimizer-focused-rtx.log 2>&1
.venv/bin/python benchmarks/run_upstream_opinfo.py --source /workspace/pytorch-opinfo-5c488690/test/test_ops.py --out benchmarks/results/optimizer-pointwise-2026-10-19/correctness/upstream-rtx-final --match _lerp_ --match _addcmul_ --match _addcdiv_ --match _maximum_ --match _minimum_ > /tmp/pv-optimizer-upstream-rtx.log 2>&1
